verdict: All 139 T3 items in clubs / meet host tools / meet form were re-verified against the current app + engine (the triage was 2026-09-19). 13 were already built, 6 are deliberate design differences, and the rest were real gaps: 88 built in full and 10 built in part this lane, 22 deferred with a reason (mostly engine columns needing a rehearsed migration). Proven on UAT: engine probe 32/32 (every door by its registered name, each yes with its refusal, read back) and UI probe 13/13 (rendered page, EN + zh_Hant, planted fault first). Prod and UAT engines run the same image.
